title: Eco-benign spectrofluorimetric analysis of icariin in a nano-formulation using green quantum dots: insights from in vitro anticoagulant and docking studies
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,35971-35985
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04854K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Haydi S. Elbordiny, Aya R. Ahmed, Mai M. Elnaggar, Mona M. Agwa, Mahmoud A. Ragab, Sara I. Aboras
A sensitive spectrofluorimetric analysis of Icariin using green quantum dots was designed. In silico and in vitro studies on the anticoagulant potency were also investigated.
